checks.name: schemaValid
checks.description: Validates PlanTemplateArtifactDefinition has all required fields and status=candidate

checks.name: dagValid
checks.description: Validates Skill Goal DAG is acyclic with no dangling predecessor/successor references

checks.name: requiredCriteriaCovered
checks.description: Validates every required CriterionTemplate is covered by at least one node's coveredCriterionTemplateIds

checks.name: capabilityShapeValid
checks.description: Validates no node binds an exact Skill ID (skill: prefix forbidden)

checks.name: parameterPolicyValid
checks.description: Validates no parameter has trustLevel=authoritative with allowedSources=small_model_candidate

checks.name: sideEffectReplaySafe
checks.description: Validates recovery branches with explicitly_safe replay do not allow multiple applications

checks.name: boundsValid
checks.description: Validates node count <= 256, parameter count <= 128, recovery branch count <= 32

checks.name: duplicateFingerprint
checks.description: Checks candidate fingerprint against existing fingerprints for duplicate detection

errors.message: A candidate with the same fingerprint already exists

staticValidationReport.importantNote: passed_static is explicitly not a validation pass, approval or promotion signal; it is recorded as evidence only
